ISO 11228-2 single-operator push-pull envelope — from 20261102-105608_stair-climbing-hand-truck-for-parcel-cou
ISO 11228-2 and HSE guidance limit sustained one-person push-pull to roughly 200-250 N with brief heave below ~350 N using closed-loop grips at ~90-110 cm height. A 60 kg load dragged continuously up a stair slope needs ~441 N, exceeding the envelope; stepwise levered lifts in the ~226 N class or powered assist are needed to comply.
Evidence: E7 (search: EN ISO hand truck safety standard 60 kg push pull force limits: mktg.idec.com — ISO 11228-2? — https://mktg.idec.com/hubfs/EU_AWD/AWD_ISO-11228-2.pdf?hsLang=en); E8 (search: EN ISO hand truck safety standard 60 kg push pull force limits: webarchive.nationalarchives.gov.uk — Microsoft Word - updated version of report 9648.doc — https://webarchive.nationalarchives.gov.uk/ukgwa/20100707143156mp_/http://www.hse.gov.uk/research/rrpdf/rr228.pdf); E12 (search: ISO 11228-2 push pull force limits ergonomics handles: mktg.idec.com — AWD ISO 11228 2.pdf — https://mktg.idec.com/hubfs/EU_AWD/AWD_ISO-11228-2.pdf?hsLang=fr); E58 (stair heave lever effort brake torque tip margin 60kg: W=706.3N angle=38.7deg Fslope=441N Flever=226N T=98.9Nm Tsf=197.8Nm tip=21.8deg lean=25.0 margin=-3.2; energy per 0.2m riser=141J vs daily ~)

Light cold-box ground versus wind loads — from 20261102-112524_off-grid-solar-powered-cold-storage-for-
A tonne of produce spread over a few square metres imposes only ~2.5 kPa floor and soil pressure, an order of magnitude below typical allowable soil bearing of tens to >50 kPa, so bearing rarely governs lightweight cold stores. Lateral wind governs anchoring: dynamic pressure follows ~0.6 x V^2, or ~540 Pa at 30 m/s gust, yielding ~2.9 kN on a ~5 m2 side wall that must be carried by anchors, plinth fixings and separate PV supports.
Evidence: E47 (soil pressure under plinth without concrete self-weight: 2.51 kPa); E48 (floor loading from produce alone: 2.45 kPa); E64 (wind pressure at 30 m/s gust: 540 Pa); E65 (wind force on side wall: 2.86×10³ N); E43 (search: concrete slab soil bearing capacity kPa small building foundation: spaworld.co.nz — Generic Concrete Slab or Pad Building Guide | Portable Spas — https://www.spaworld.co.nz/learn/how-to-build-a-generic-concrete-slab-or-pad-for-a-portable-spa-pool/); E44 (search: concrete slab soil bearing capacity kPa small building foundation: amcfoam.com — Revised: March 2010 — 2010 — https://amcfoam.com/PDFs/Normal%20and%20Problem%20Soils.pdf)

Pedestrian crowd resonant force model — from 20261102-121628_vibration-retrofit-for-a-lively-pedestri
Vertical walking force is modeled as ~700 N body weight with ~280 N (~40%) first harmonic at step resonance. Sparse walkers add linearly, but dense crowd Class III ~0.5 pedestrians/m2 uses imperfect synchronization: equivalent in-phase count Neq ~ 10.8*sqrt(zeta*N) acting together at resonance, producing kN-scale harmonic force and multi-m/s2 bare-deck acceleration when structural damping is ~0.5-1%.
